text: maya: quick design review — timeout banner copy for console session. hitting an accessibility and length nit. can we tighten the primary CTA? aj: I like 'Continue session' over 'Sign back in'. 'Sign back in' implies re-entering creds, which we don't do for SSO :thinking_face: natalie: Prefer 'Continue session' for scannability. Short, action-oriented. :thumbsup: kyle: Secondary action currently 'Log out' — propose 'End session' (softer). Also ensure button touch target >=44px for a11y. sam: Quick copy options (<=40 chars): A) Continue session B) Resume session C) Sign back in Secondary: End session / Log out / Switch account aj: small markup for how it shows in the banner: ``` Your session will expire in 2:00 ``` natalie: color contrast check: current dark-gray on light-yellow is ~3.2:1 — needs 4.5:1 for body text. Options: darken text or use darker bg with border. maya: good catch. if we darken text it must still pass on mobile. kyle, can you try tokens? kyle: will try token swaps. if bg stuck, we can bold the CTA label and add 1px outline to the secondary. sam: UX Q: show exact countdown (1:59) or relative ('about 2 minutes')? I'd vote for exact — it reduces uncertainty. maya: final asks: (1) pick primary copy (vote in thread) (2) devs add aria-labels (aria-label="Continue session — keeps you signed in") (3) accessibility check before rollout aj: Vote: Continue session natalie: Vote: Continue session kyle: Vote: End session (secondary) deploy-bot: Deployed banner v2 to staging for testing — link: https://staging.redwood.com/console (check contrast and mobile) maya: thanks everyone — I'll update the mock with chosen copy and drop in the PR.
